pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions. Patches on the lower neck are larger with moderately rounded edges. Patches on the flank exhibit higher angularity and smaller surface area. Edge gradients are sharp with high contrast against the inter-patch space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored inter-patch pathways forming a contiguous topological web. Junction nodes are mostly tri-radial. Corridor width is consistent, exhibiting a thickness approximately 15-20% of the adjacent patch diameter.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A serrated silhouette is visible along the dorsal ridge of the neck. It consists of high-frequency, low-amplitude projections against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A structural break in the mane continuity is observed at the junction of the lower neck and the shoulder.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical indentation or linear skin fold is present on the anterior shoulder, disrupting the lateral pattern flow.
other_distinctive_markers: A pronounced reduction in patch size is observed along the cranio-caudal axis, with patches becoming significantly more fragmented and densely packed toward the posterior.
